newsitem.title: MEXICO: Cemex Colombia plant running normal after accident.
newsitem.headline: Cemex Colombia plant running normal after accident.

text.p: The Ibague cement plant in central Colombia returned to normal production on Wednesday following an accident on Friday that killed 10 workers, the plant's parent company said on Wednesday..
The plant belongs to Cementos Diamante, the Colombian unit of Mexican cement giant Cemex.
"The plant will be at 100 percent (on Wednesday), but technicians from the company will continue investigating in depth the causes of the accident," a Cemex official told Reuters.
An explosion roared through part of the three-year-old plant on Friday, causing a cloud of red-hot material to rain down on workers, witnesses told reporters in Colombia.
Ten workers died of third-degree burns, and another seven workers were injured.
